steps.code:
# Now I'll write code to parse each file, create the necessary directories, and move the files.
import os

base_dir = "~/documents/work/meetings_data/"
for file_path in files:
    # Extract the filename from the path
    filename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    # Split into name and extension
    name, ext = os.path.splitext(filename)
    # Split the name into date and file_name
    parts = name.split("__", 1)
    date = parts[0]
    file_name = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""
    
    # Create the directory for file_name
    dir_path = base_dir + file_name + "/"
    create_resp = apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=dir_path)
    print(f"Create dir {dir_path}: {create_resp}")
    
    # Move the file to the new directory with the new name
    dest_path = dir_path + date + ext
    move_resp = apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=access_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=dest_path)
    print(f"Move {file_path} -> {dest_path}: {move_resp}")
